tasks: Upload universal, ARM64, and ARMv7 APK artifacts
implementation: Three-hour lazy EPG guide window with clipped, non-overlapping entries and gap spacing.
Guide and Now modes are shown only when matching XMLTV programs exist.
Playback actions are exposed only when a channel has a stream URL.
The 30-second Now-mode ticker is suspended while the Guide is visible.
JVM tests cover clipping, gaps, overlapping entries, and invalid/expired windows.
Instrumentation test covers XMLTV-only rows without playback actions.
unitTestEvidence: Selected unit tests passed, including GuideTimelineTest and the existing Live TV and low-memory tests.
instrumentationEvidence: The Android instrumentation source set compiled; instrumented tests were not executed.
limitations: Debug APKs signed with the CI debug key; not a production release.
Instrumented tests compiled but were not executed on hardware.
No Android TV Box was connected through ADB for visual or physical performance QA.
